scope: Only the two exact local helper/test sources below, with existing dependencies read as context. This review does not admit a collector, runner, dataset, training plan, scorer, loss, KEEP policy or GPU execution.
attribution_note: The requested audit route is not exposed by the current tool schema. No Astra execution, independent-family review or scientific acceptance is claimed.

target.review_binding: Exact local source bytes only; canonical deployment and runtime binding remain outside this helper review.

preserved_design_context.disposition: Preserved unchanged. This helper implements only the coordinate/feature extraction portion of the implementation contract; other design requirements remain applicable.

engineering_checks.name: exact_source_binding
engineering_checks.evidence: Both helper and test file-byte SHA256 values exactly match the requested values. These are helper source identities, not a full executable source/input map.

engineering_checks.name: collector_coordinate_formula
engineering_checks.evidence: The helper preserves float32 returned xywh and crop geometry, computes the centre using the Python [left, top] list with the same mixed-precision operation order, divides by side, and casts the concatenated cxcywh result to float32. Single-box and batched collector formulas produced identical float32 bytes in 12000 deterministic geometry cases.
engineering_checks.limit: Exactness is established for the existing float32 crop-geometry/returned-box contract. Arbitrary float64 geometry or reduced-precision search tensors are not claimed equivalent. The helper moves normalized_tensor to the supplied search tensor's device and dtype.

engineering_checks.name: modality_order_and_feature_space
engineering_checks.evidence: The range(2) loop uses channels0:3 for RGB followed by channels3:6 for TIR, including both fixed initial template slots. Each modality calls the existing full-grid encode once and pools the same supplied current box with primary_candidate_evidence. Stacking yields features(2,768), coverage(2), normalized_box(4). Under the same frozen model, fixed templates and crop contract this uses the candidate identity feature definition.
engineering_checks.limit: No real encoder or candidate feature equality was executed. Correct caller-provided crop pixels, template provenance and checkpoint identity are not established by tensor shapes.

engineering_checks.name: minimal_neural_call_graph
engineering_checks.evidence: Exactly two encode calls are specified, each without sparse indices and thus with the existing full256-search-token path. There is no primary, predict, decode, box_head, anchor recomputation or candidate generation call. This is the intended extra evidence cost, not the total cost of a future causal replay.

engineering_checks.name: coverage_and_roi_semantics
engineering_checks.evidence: The unchanged ROI helper samples a3x3 lattice with bilinear grid_sample, align_corners=False, masks points outside normalized[0,1), and averages all nine samples. Coverage is the fraction of lattice points in bounds, not image-area overlap, GT visibility or a guarantee that the whole box lies inside the crop. Fully uncovered ROIs yield coverage0 and a zero descriptor.
engineering_checks.partial_coverage_clarification: Partial coverage is retained as a fractional value with the corresponding masked descriptor; it is not automatically zeroed whenever coverage<1. This preserves original candidate evidence semantics. The future scorer must decide trust/KEEP separately; this helper does not implement that policy.

engineering_checks.name: read_only_and_no_gradient
engineering_checks.evidence: torch.no_grad wraps both encodes and ROI pooling; model.training must be false. Helper arithmetic does not write into supplied boxes, geometry, search or templates. The inspected native encode path constructs intermediate tensors without updating these inputs. Features/coverage are detached clones and normalized_box is copied. No tracker attributes, observer hook, scorer, optimizer, backward or file writes occur.
engineering_checks.limit: This is a source-level conclusion for the inspected native eval encoder, not a runtime frozen-state witness for an arbitrary supplied model. The future caller still owns eval/frozen checkpoint setup, original E0 parity and before/after state verification.

engineering_checks.name: no_labels_or_action_commit
engineering_checks.evidence: Inputs contain no annotation, overlap, state label, target index, future frame or test label. The helper returns observations only. It neither clips/replaces the supplied box nor changes history/templates/routes/counters, and cannot itself select KEEP or a replacement.

engineering_checks.name: test_source_scope
engineering_checks.evidence: The two new tests use a synthetic encoder, cover modality slicing, two calls, expected geometry, output shape/no-gradient, input preservation and a fully uncovered ROI. The geometry test obtains geometry through crop_pair and supplies synthetic search pixels; it does not establish original six_channel_crop pixels or import-order parity.
engineering_checks.limit: These tests do not exercise a real frozen encoder, parameter/buffer parity, caller cache alignment, partial-coverage cases or a collector. The existing five identity tests include learned head forward/backward/optimizer execution; none was rerun under the no-model-execution instruction.

caller_contract_not_admitted_here: Supply the actual preceding-state current-image crop and geometry using original six_channel_crop/import semantics, factor4 and size256, aligned with the accepted cached previous prediction.
Supply the clipped returned current E0 prediction, not the pre-clipping normalized box or a recentered search crop.
Supply the immutable first-frame pair of templates and the exact accepted frozen E0 checkpoint. Shapes alone cannot enforce fixed-initial provenance.
Join evidence by exact sequence/frame/parent-cache hashes and require original-trajectory parity. This helper contains no dataset or cache binding.
Keep the original914-dimensional observer contract and single-hook ownership separate from this dual-modal fixed-template matching evidence.
Implement coverage-based KEEP availability, relative labels/scoring/loss and TRAIN acceptance only in the separately reviewed future work.

syntax_validation.method: In-memory compile of the nine inspected helper/test and existing coordinate/model context files; no imports or bytecode writes.

coordinate_comparison.method: AST extraction of the actual collector normalized_cxcywh and the helper's NumPy normalization statements, evaluated on float32 fractional/large/off-crop boxes and positive crop sides. Compare dtype and output bytes.

user_reported_tests.reason: Review kept to source inspection, syntax and NumPy arithmetic under the explicit no-model-execution instruction.

claim_ceiling: SOURCE_PASS with zero blocking issues for the exact two helper/test hashes, within the original float32 crop/box and native eval-encoder contract. This grants no collector/runner/plan or GPU admission and establishes no measured feature parity, learned decision quality, tracking gain or scientific acceptance.
